name: paymentflow
description: The official PaymentFlow API client for Node.js and TypeScript.
//sideEffects: Nothing in this package runs at import time - every module only declares. Saying so lets a
bundler drop whatever an application does not reference, which matters because a webhook
receiver importing only `constructEvent` has no reason to carry the transport, the eleven
resource namespaces, or the generated model types.
//test: Neither `node --test test/` nor `node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"` runs this suite on every
version the package supports - the directory form fails on Node 22+, the glob form fails on
Node 20, which is what CI pins. scripts/run-tests.mjs enumerates the files and passes them
explicitly, which is the one form all of them accept. Its header has the detail.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize-dual-build.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run typecheck:examples
